headline: README refresh — full primitive surface documented
summary: The README's `What ships` section now reflects every primitive landed since the foundation patch: catalog, cart, pricing, tax, shipping, payment, order, checkout, email, storefront, admin. Includes a `Operator quick-start` block walking through `wrangler login` → resource provisioning → secret setting → migration apply → deploy → seed-a-product.

items.title: README documents every primitive
items.body: The `What ships` section is now split into Platform / Commerce primitives / Migrations applied to D1 / Tests subsections. Each primitive entry lists its module path, its function, and the composed blamejs surface it relies on. The Operator quick-start block carries the canonical wrangler one-time setup + deploy + seed-a-product command sequence so an operator landing on the repo has an unambiguous path from clone to live shop.
